sent: This is a normal heartbeat. [pause 0.3] The S-A node fires, the signal travels down through the A-V node, and both ventricles squeeze together. [pause 0.45] Now watch what happens in asystole. [pause 0.35] All electrical activity stops. [pause 0.35] Nothing fires, and the heart stays still. [pause 0.4] A flat line, and no pulse. [pause 0.35] Check the leads and the gain, so fine Vee-fib isn't missed. [pause 0.45] Asystole is not shockable. [pause 0.35] Start CPR, give epinephrine as soon as possible, and look for the cause. [pause 0.5] Practice it on A-C-L-S med Sim. [pause 0.35] A-C-L-S med dot com. [pause 1.2]
